issues.issue: Should the RAD admit the appellant's new evidence (affidavits, video clips, news articles) on appeal?
issues.applicant_position: Affidavits unavailable at hearing; video/news show recent attacks on Muslims.
issues.result_text: Affidavits rejected; video clips/news articles admitted as new evidence.

issues.issue: Should the RAD grant an oral hearing due to alleged interpretation error affecting credibility?
issues.applicant_position: Interpretation error caused credibility loss; oral hearing required.
issues.result_text: Oral hearing request denied; credibility not determinative.

issues.issue: Did the RPD err in finding a viable internal flight alternative (IFA) in Jaipur or New Delhi?
issues.applicant_position: He will be traced anywhere in India; new evidence shows attacks on Muslims in IFAs.
issues.result_text: RPD correct; appellant failed to prove IFA is not viable.
